title: John Lear: the moon was built at Jupiter and towed to Earth

tellings.quote: they built the moon on Jupiter. And uh that's where they manufactured it and they towed it into Earth's orbit.

plain: A man named Bob Lazar, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, repeats an idea he heard from a man named John Lear. Lazar says Lear's claim was that someone built the moon at Jupiter and then towed it into orbit around Earth. If true, it would mean the moon itself is a made object.
